compliance.title: How this stays within the rules
compliance.official: Official channels only: a real version works through the platform's approved APIs and tools, within its terms. This demo connects to nothing.
compliance.assisted: Assisted drafting: the assistant researches and drafts, a person reads, edits and decides, one message at a time.
compliance.qualify: Qualification first: the assistant also says who should not be contacted, and respects every request to stop.
compliance.minimal: Business information only: role, company, public company news. Nothing personal.

forbidden.title: What this approach never does
forbidden.scraping: Scrape profiles or web pages, or collect data in bulk.
forbidden.automation: Automate an account: no bots, no browser scripts, no fake accounts.
forbidden.bulk: Send in bulk or in sequences: there is no "approve all" and no automatic follow-up.
forbidden.unapproved: Schedule or send a message a person has not read and approved.

boundary.title: Who does what
boundary.auto: On its own: researching the company, rating the fit, preparing the draft.
boundary.approval: Only with your approval: scheduling a message. Nothing is scheduled before that, and the approval is for one prospect at a time.

docIntel.disclosure: This is a simulation. No AI model is called: the fields are read and the questions answered with fixed rules, on this page and without a network, on invented documents. You cannot upload files, so nobody's data is processed. A real system would use a language model and your own documents, with the same human check you see here for doubtful values.
docIntel.noscript: The demo needs JavaScript. The sample documents are shown below; enable JavaScript to see the fields read and the questions answered.
docIntel.ctaTitle: Need something like this for your documents?
docIntel.ctaBody: Tell me which documents reach you today and what you do with them: I will tell you what can be read automatically, and what a person should still check.
docIntel.brand: Three sample documents between fictional companies: an invoice, a service contract and a transport document.
docIntel.intro: Pick a document and have it read. The demo pulls out the key facts as structured fields, flags what it is not sure about for a person to check, and answers questions showing the exact sentence and page each answer comes from.

limits.title: How this stays safe
limits.upload: No uploads: you cannot add your own files in this version. The demo only opens the three sample documents bundled with the page.
limits.synthetic: Invented documents: the companies, people, numbers and addresses are made up.
limits.rules: Closed processing: everything runs on this page with fixed rules. Nothing is sent to a server and no AI model is called.
limits.review: A person decides on doubtful values: unclear or handwritten values are flagged, and stay flagged until someone marks them as checked.
limits.future: A real project that reads your own documents would first need an agreed purpose, a data-processing agreement and a retention rule.
